description:
We can now play Original XBOX Games on Android! The new Xbox emulator for Android (X1Box) is finally here, and in this video, I walk you through setting it up step-by-step.
Based on the popular Xemu PC emulator, X1Box allows you to run classic original Xbox games on your Android phone, tablet, or gaming handheld. I’ll show you where to get the app, how to set up your BIOS and HDD files, and the absolute best settings to tweak (like Vulkan vs. OpenGL, CPU threading, and FPU) to get the highest frame rates possible.
